messages:
Mira (ML): quick heads-up — new reranker 'quickspin-v2' bringup shows ~3.7% NDCG@10 drop vs quickspin-v1 after PTQ int8 pass. numbers from eval-harness: v1=0.423, v2-int8=0.407. :thinking_face:
Ashu (Infra): :eyes: did we compare float32 vs int8 on the same eval dataset split?
Mira (ML): yes ran float32 locally — v2-fp32=0.422 so it's specifically the quant path.
Devin (Eval): do we have the candidate ordering / doc-format parity between runs? last time formatting drifted and gave a weird delta.
Mira (ML): good point — I used the new candidate sampler (cohort=quickspin-prod) which shuffles metadata slightly. re-ran with canonical ordering, still ~3.5% drop.
Sam (SRE): any infra differences? different batch sizes or KV cache packing changes? those can affect quant traces.
Ashu (Infra): checked autoscaler/instance types — same GPU family. but we switched to kvpack-v2 in the build that created the int8 artifact. could be packing alignment.
Devin (Eval): can you run a minimal eval with identical candidate prep and no kvpack (force legacy) to isolate?
Mira (ML): running now on a small holdout (5k queries), command:
```
python eval_harness/run_eval.py --model quickspin-v2 --quant int8 --holdout holdout_v2.json --order canonical --no-kvpack
```
Mira (ML): result: ndcg@10=0.419 on that small holdout (less drop). so kvpack might be amplifying quant error.
Ashu (Infra): hmm. maybe quant kernel alignment + kvpack memory layout causes subtle fp accumulation. I'll spin a debug build that logs per-layer dequant stats.
Devin (Eval): also try measuring MRR@10 and per-query delta distribution (percentiles). sometimes a small average NDCG change hides long-tail failures.
Mira (ML): MRR@10 numbers: v1=0.358, v2-int8=0.346 on the full harness. per-query deltas show a 0.8% tail of queries with >0.2 drop.
Sam (SRE): canary-bot reports no latency regressions in prod inference path; throughput fine. so not perf.
Ashu (Infra): I'll run a targeted repro where we quantize only the last 2 transformer layers vs whole model to see sensitivity. attaching quick config snippet:
```
quantize:
  method: ptq
  skip_layers: [0..-3]
```
Devin (Eval): also check tokenizer normalization — earlier we saw micro differences when whitespace stripping was toggled. run exact tokenized hash compare between v1/v2 candidates.
Mira (ML): did that: token hash identical across runs.
Devin (Eval): OK. next steps I recommend:
- Ashu: reproduce with/without kvpack + per-layer quant toggle
- Mira: compute percentile deltas and push a 1k-query human review of top failures
- Sam: keep an eye on rollout canary; block full roll if top-1 regressions exceed threshold
Mira (ML): agreed. I'll post short failure examples here for quick triage (top-1 mismatches).
Ashu (Infra): starting repro now. ETA ~2h. I'll post logs. :gear:
Mira (ML): thanks — will queue human review and share labels. :thumbsup:
canary-bot: Canary check: quickspin-v2-int8 canary run completed — no infra alerts.
Devin (Eval): if kvpack is root cause we can try reordering pack to align quant block boundaries as a mitigation. small perf trade but maybe worth it for quality.
Sam (SRE): keep me posted before any config changes to packing; will coordinate a staged rollout.
Mira (ML): filing a short ticket with reproducer and sample fails. will tag team.
Ashu (Infra): posted repro logs: https://redwood-internal/ci/logs/1767778888/kvpack-repro — looks like layer 23 dequant scale variance spikes in int8 artifact.
Devin (Eval): nice. one more quick sanity: run float32 artifact on the exact same binary that serves int8 (disable quant runtime) to rule out runtime changes.
Mira (ML): done — float32 on same runtime matches baseline. so quant path + kvpack interaction is the suspect.
Sam (SRE): ok plan: keep canary, delay wider rollout, Ashu + Mira dig in, Devin prepare rollback plan.
Mira (ML): thanks all. will update thread with human review batch and ticket link. :sparkles:
